title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Enhanced!
summary: Experience enhanced capabilities and unlock new insights with the official launch of the Spyglass tool, now refined and ready for all users.

title: Complete Control Over Your Media in the Editor
summary: Take full command of your embedded images, documents, and other media directly within the editor, with intuitive options to upload, remove, download, and customize their display.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap!
summary: We're thrilled to introduce our new public roadmap, providing a clear and engaging overview of our recent achievements and exciting future developments.

title: Streamlined Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Enjoy a more seamless experience with our newly improved checkboxes, now larger, easier to drag, and beautifully integrated into our modern interface.

title: Improved Live Collaboration
summary: We've made real-time collaboration effortless and more intuitive, ensuring your team can work together with unparalleled ease.

title: Enhanced Discovery of Shared Content
summary: Now you can effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with friends, making teamwork more seamless than ever.

title: Unlock Global Languages
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive support for international languages, making Noeko truly accessible to users around the globe.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko's codebase is now fully open source, empowering our community with unparalleled transparency, control, and a direct path to contribute to its evolution.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge Universe
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity and power, as the Constellation view gains intelligent filtering by tags, time, and shared connections, making every discovery intuitive and impactful.

title: Master Your Knowledge with Advanced Search Filters
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your essential information using powerful new filters, sorting options, and the ability to save your custom knowledge collections for instant access.

title: Smarter Content Connections
summary: Unleash your creativity with powerful new display options that bring your interconnected ideas to life directly within your notes, making your workflow more intuitive and insightful.

title: Noeko: Self-Host Your Way, Power Your Work
summary: Get ready to take control with Noeko's new self-hosting capabilities and unlock advanced features through our upcoming paid plans.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Visual Enhancements
summary: Prepare for a stunning visual refresh as we refine current themes and introduce an exciting collection of new design options to personalize your experience.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: We're enhancing our in-app greetings to perfectly match your local time, ensuring a more personal and accurate experience throughout your day.

title: Instant Actions for Your Lists
summary: Effortlessly manage your items by performing essential actions like removing tags, deleting, or viewing directly from any list, dramatically boosting your productivity.

title: Unlock a World of New Information Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in and interact with a wider variety of content, from YouTube videos and websites to text files, making all your valuable information accessible in one place.
